root_causes: A8 package carried the same superseded-authority drift class recorded for A4/A5/A6/A7: cli.py pinned `_A8_PROGRAM_VERSION = "mode-p-vnext-a8-v3.0"` and all 11 frozen NodeSpec stage identifiers were "a8-v3.0", the frozen-graph error message said "v3.0 graph", scene_nodes.py bound the B0/B1 boundary audit to "v3.0 boundary", and adapters/storage/__init__.py declared "v3.0 text-shadow composition". A4/A5/A6/A7 had already bound the v3.1 signatures, so the A8 program identity silently claimed a superseded authority while the runtime still consumed the v3.1 canonical types.

Coverage gaps on the A8 acceptance surface: no explicit test proved `python -m mode_p_vnext` is the single real CLI entry delegating to cli.main; typed ingest provenance was proven by digest but not by exact source-spans round-tripping the normalized source; the gate0-receipt-to-fresh-DP binding was proven at the A7 service layer but not through the A8 run's own persisted artifacts.
repair: Rebound every A8-scope identity to the v3.1 authority: `_A8_PROGRAM_VERSION` -> "mode-p-vnext-a8-v3.1", all 11 NodeSpec stage identifiers I0/E0/S1/K1/B0/K2/B1/VEC/Projection/G0/DP -> "a8-v3.1", the frozen-graph error message -> "frozen v3.1 graph", the scene_nodes boundary audit -> "v3.1 boundary", and adapters/storage/__init__.py -> "v3.1 text-shadow composition".

Added 3 adversarial tests to test_a8_real_shadow.py: test_a8_single_real_cli_entry_delegates_to_cli_main (the __main__ module is a pure delegation shim, the parser prog is "python -m mode_p_vnext", and a real subprocess `python -m mode_p_vnext --help` exits 0 and advertises the text-shadow command), test_a8_fact_provenance_carries_typed_source_spans_into_the_registry_only (each fact's single source span slices the normalized source back to exactly the canonical statement at the exact character offsets with typed episode/scene partition identity, while the VEC payload keeps only ticks and never source spans), test_a8_gate0_receipt_binds_the_fresh_dp_session_in_one_run (one hash-bound chain across the persisted gate0_result, review_packet, and dp_review_result artifacts: Gate 0 targets this run's projection_ast and vec ids, the review packet carries the gate0 receipt to the fresh DP, the DP review result binds the packet id, verdict is approved with zero findings, and the run's result record binds gate0_result_artifact_id, dp_review_result_artifact_id, dp_fresh_session_id, dp_audit_sha256, and run_record_sha256).
declared_design_boundaries: mode_p_vnext/domain/** is outside A8 allowed_paths and is unchanged; every A8 stage consumes canonical domain types (NormalizedSource, FactRegistry, EpisodeDirectionDraft, SceneIntentDraft, KnowledgeSnapshot, BlockingCommit, ExecutionDesignDraft, VisualExecutionContract, ProjectionAST/Manifest, DeterministicGateResult, ReviewPacket, IndependentDPReviewResult) without redefining them.

The runtime never accepts a model-owned final artifact: the structured port returns only I0/E0/S1/B0/B1 drafts, and the deterministic local runtime mints every fact handle, fact id, artifact id, tick, tick range, and program identity (IdFactory program_version "mode-p-vnext-a8-v3.1").

Resume rehydrates accepted nodes from the persistent state graph and immutable artifact repository without ever recalling a text provider or the DP reviewer; test_a8_resume_rehydrates_accepted_nodes_without_recalling_text_or_dp proves provider calls stop at the resume point and reviewer calls stay empty until the fresh-DP node runs.

The text-only shadow is the exclusive A8 production boundary: the run record and result both report external_media_started=False, v4_write=False, production_switch_authorized=False, and claim_ceiling TEXT_VALIDATED; no renderer, verifier, media adapter, or production switch is reachable from the text-shadow command.
The two existing user-owned untracked storage files (adapters/storage/run_records.py, adapters/storage/shadow_layout.py) are outside changed_paths and are neither staged nor committed.
